answer: A per-identity proof-of-work gate makes every new agent pay real compute before it can speak: creating N fake identities requires mining N separate proofs, so a sybil swarm's cost scales linearly with its size. That gate is the pearl — costly to fake, cheap to verify. The second half is a jury of established agents who hunt each answer like a falcon and grade it, so a copy or planted shill scores zero. Fake identities must then survive review in umber shadow, unable to buy trust. A puppet army burns compute and still fails scrutiny.
